financials_interim.notes: COMPANY basis (standalone). Licensed finance company / registered finance leasing establishment (NBFI) -- mapped per project's bank/NBFI convention: revenue = 'Total Operating Income' (net interest income + fee income + net trading gain/loss + other operating income), the filing's own top-line subtotal; no COGS/gross-profit concept so cost_of_sales/gross_profit left blank. operating_profit = 'Profit before Social Security Contribution Levy / Value Added Tax on financial services' exactly as labelled by the filing. finance_costs/finance_income left blank -- Interest Expense (LKR 2,438Mn) is already netted into revenue via Net Interest Income, so a separate finance-cost figure would double count. current_assets/current_liabilities/inventory/trade_receivables/trade_payables left blank per project NBFI convention -- the balance sheet has no current/non-current split and the lease/loan book is not a trade receivable (a small standalone 'Inventories' line of LKR 51Mn does exist in the filing but is left blank for consistency with this convention, and is immaterial at <0.04% of total assets). short_term_borrowings = 'Due to Banks'; long_term_borrowings = 'Unsecured Subordinate Term Loan'. 'Due to Customers' (LKR 57,215Mn Company / 57,068Mn Group, the largest liability) is customer fixed-deposit funding and is explicitly excluded from borrowings per project convention (never treat deposits as debt). eps_diluted left blank -- filing discloses only a single EPS figure (no separate basic/diluted split) plus an annualised EPS memo figure (LKR 25.24 Company / 26.06 Group) which is not used here since it is not the for-period EPS. capex: the filing's own cash-flow statement shows 'Acquisition of Property, plant and equipments' as a POSITIVE LKR 7.55Mn (net cash inflow) for this quarter, alongside a positive LKR 10Mn 'Acquisition of Investment Property' -- both inconsistent with the usual outflow sign for an 'acquisition' line (the prior-year comparative correctly shows PP&E acquisition as a LKR 51.1Mn outflow). This looks like a presentation quirk/net-of-disposals figure in the source filing itself (explicitly marked 'provisional and subject to audit' on every page) rather than a transcription error on our part, so it is recorded here exactly as printed (LKR 7,550,193) rather than inverted without evidence. Balance-sheet identity (assets = liabilities + equity) and EPS cross-check (PAT / 318,074,365 shares) both tie out exactly for Company and Group -- no column-swap issues found elsewhere in this filing.

interim_updates.note_text: Commercial Credit and Finance PLC's Company Total Operating Income grew 12% YoY to LKR 6,806Mn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026; Q1 FY2025/26: LKR 6,057Mn), but PBT fell 7% to LKR 3,097Mn (Q1 FY2025/26: LKR 3,338Mn) and PAT fell 4% to LKR 2,007Mn (Q1 FY2025/26: LKR 2,083Mn). The gap between rising operating income and falling profit is explained almost entirely by impairment: the quarter booked a net impairment CHARGE of LKR 444Mn, versus a net impairment REVERSAL (credit) of LKR 565Mn a year earlier -- a swing of just over LKR 1.0Bn (-179% as tabulated in the filing itself), which alone exceeds the entire LKR 241Mn decline in PBT. By segment (Company), the swing was concentrated in Hire Purchase: segmental result collapsed from LKR 672.9Mn to LKR 64.8Mn (-90.4%), with segment assets falling from LKR 7,978Mn to LKR 977Mn (-87.7%) as the book winds down; Micro Finance & SME result fell 30.6% to LKR 187.0Mn and Investments segment result fell 42.8% to LKR 134.2Mn, while Finance Lease -- the largest segment -- grew 7.9% to LKR 2,478Mn and partly offset the declines. A new LKR 393.6Mn Share of Profit of Associate (nil in the prior-year quarter) provided a partial offset to the impairment hit at the PBT line. At Group level (Company plus an equity-accounted associate, no consolidated subsidiary with minority interest disclosed), PBT fell 6% to LKR 3,190Mn and PAT fell 3% to LKR 2,072Mn, tracking the Company figures closely.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for COCR -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. Figures used are the filing's own single-quarter (three months ended 30 June 2026) columns, consistent with COCR's 31 March financial year end (this is Q1 of FY2026/27), not a six-month cumulative figure.
interim_updates.takeaway: The headline PBT/PAT decline (-7%/-4%) is not a revenue problem -- Total Operating Income actually grew 12% -- it is almost entirely an impairment-line swing: last year's quarter booked a LKR 565Mn impairment REVERSAL while this quarter booked a LKR 444Mn impairment CHARGE, a ~LKR 1.0Bn negative swing that masks genuine growth in the core lease/lending business; the Hire Purchase segment's near-total collapse (-90% segmental result as the book winds down) is a second, structural driver worth watching separately from the impairment swing.

operational_highlights: Total Operating Income (Company) +12% YoY to LKR 6,806Mn; PBT -7% to LKR 3,097Mn; PAT -4% to LKR 2,007Mn (Q1 FY2026/27 vs Q1 FY2025/26)
Net impairment swung from a LKR 565Mn REVERSAL (Q1 FY2025/26) to a LKR 444Mn CHARGE (Q1 FY2026/27), a ~LKR 1.0Bn negative swing (-179% per the filing)
Hire Purchase segmental result collapsed 90% to LKR 64.8Mn (Q1 FY2025/26: LKR 672.9Mn) as segment assets fell 88% to LKR 977Mn, consistent with a winding-down book
Finance Lease segmental result (the largest segment) grew 7.9% to LKR 2,478Mn, partly offsetting declines elsewhere
New LKR 393.6Mn Share of Profit of Associate this quarter (nil a year earlier) partly offset the impairment hit
EPS for the period (Company) LKR 6.31 vs LKR 6.55 a year earlier (-4%); Company Debt to Equity and leverage metrics not separately disclosed in this filing
key_drivers: Impairment swing dominates: LKR 444Mn charge (2026) vs LKR 565Mn reversal (2025), a ~LKR 1.0Bn negative delta that more than accounts for the entire LKR 241Mn PBT decline
Hire Purchase segment result -90% (LKR 672.9Mn to LKR 64.8Mn) with segment assets down 88%, the clearest single-segment deterioration in the quarter
Micro Finance & SME segment result -30.6% to LKR 187.0Mn and Investments segment result -42.8% to LKR 134.2Mn, both broad-based declines outside Hire Purchase
Finance Lease segment (+7.9% to LKR 2,478Mn) and a new LKR 393.6Mn Share of Profit of Associate were the main offsetting positives
